slogan_validation.format_category: authority/role humor (humor 33% + identity 17% hybrid in load-bearing categories)
slogan_validation.format_category_evidence: Identity (Dachshund Dad Club BSR 267K, Floral Doxie Mama 396K) + humor (33% of niche) -- this hybrid is load-bearing
slogan_validation.cross_niche_template_check: 'Treat Inspector' is dog-niche generic (works for any dog); the 'Doxie Quality Control' secondary anchors specifically to dachshund via the breed nickname
slogan_validation.mirror_or_invent: hybrid (mirror an external-feedback design concept + invent niche-anchored slogan refinement)
slogan_validation.mirror_reasoning: Concept came from GPT external feedback as one of three suggested authority-role humor designs. My version simplifies the composition for Amazon thumbnail readability (less forest backdrop, cleaner badge frame) and tightens the slogan with a niche-anchored secondary ('Doxie Quality Control' instead of generic 'Quality Control Department'). Tests authority-humor in a non-security category as a complement to Head of Security / Squirrels.

design_feedback_disposition.external_treat_inspector_concept: ADAPTED - simplified composition + tightened slogan with niche keyword
design_feedback_disposition.external_chief_squirrel_detection_office: SKIPPED - the GPT version uses a cigar and tactical military gear, which are avoidable Amazon content-moderation risks. The role concept is fine but the execution narrows the audience and risks listing rejection.
